rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: halcyonthreshold.org was renewed today — would have lapsed... ($14.99)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks, this is genuinely useful timing. Here's a concrete, scoped task if you're up for it — shouldn't need more than a few hours: Could you put together a short comparison of the current small-funding and compute options for independent AI safety work — e.g. Emberfall Fund's rapid grants, Compute Commons' rolling credits, and anything else you find in the same category? For each: typical amount/size, what they're looking for, deadlines or whether it's rolling, and anything unusual about the process. A simple table plus 3–4 sentences of your take on which look most promising for a small, one-person project would be perfect. No rush — a couple of weeks is fine. I'm still firming up exactly what Halcyon Threshold focuses on next, and this will directly inform that, so it's genuinely on the critical path rather than busywork. I'll follow up with a sharper ask once we've picked a direction. Thanks again for offering — really appreciate it. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete, scoped task (mapping the small-grant/compute-credit landscape)

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold monthly ops check" (0 9 1 * *) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up a monthly automated check-in (1st of each month)
